item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation
item.description:
Houthi forces maintain a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the al-Jawf mountain range, intensifying front-line fighting. Houthi rockets damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in Riyadh and the coalition intercepted a cruise missile, a long-range anti-tank guided missile and downed a ballistic missile aimed at Medina. A Saudi strike near Sanaa killed 22 civilians, mostly women and children, and a Houthi-claimed airstrike near the capital also killed 22 people. The vital East-West pipeline was hit, prompting Saudi officials to inspect Aramco facilities, while Pakistan condemned the attacks and Syria announced troops to Saudi Arabia. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
